findings.issue_summary: App processes camera frame input for real-time vibe inference.
findings.evidence: Camera frames are processed ephemerally for Lyria atmosphere music generation and are encrypted in transit via WSS/TLS.
findings.recommendation: Declare Photo/Video collection in the Play Console Data Safety form under App Functionality with Encryption in Transit enabled.

findings.issue_summary: App accesses microphone for voice vibe streaming and podcast generation.
findings.evidence: Audio stream is processed ephemerally for Google Cloud AI Model Garden podcast and voice inputs.
findings.recommendation: Declare Audio collection in the Data Safety form under App Functionality.

findings.issue_summary: Firebase Auth and App Check tokens used for secure client validation.
findings.evidence: Firebase App Check safety tokens are transmitted over TLS to authenticate backend requests.
findings.recommendation: Declare App Identifiers under Security & Account Management in Play Console Data Safety.

findings.issue_summary: Foreground service declared and active for smart glasses camera, microphone, and media playback streaming.
findings.evidence: WearableStreamingService is declared with android:foregroundServiceType="camera|microphone|mediaPlayback" and implements startForeground() with notification.
findings.recommendation: Play Console Declaration Required: Ensure you complete the Foreground Service declaration form in Play Console (App content section) for camera, microphone, and mediaPlayback types prior to submission.

findings.issue_summary: CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT runtime permissions requested.
findings.evidence: Manifest requests CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT for Meta Wearables smart glasses video feed and voice AI generation.
findings.recommendation: Provide clear runtime rationale dialogs explaining why camera and audio access are required before requesting permissions.

findings.issue_summary: App displays or contains a login screen, registration wall, or authentication interface.
findings.evidence: LoginScreen.kt implements email/password authentication (loginWithEmail) and AuthOptionsScreen.kt provides login and registration buttons.
findings.recommendation:
Administrative Console Requirements: Because your app implements a login flow, you MUST complete two manual setup steps in the Play Console dashboard to pass review:
1. Reviewer Demo Credentials: Submit active, non-expiring test credentials so Google Play reviewers can access your gated features.
2. Account Deletion Link: Submit a public-facing web link for account deletion to satisfy Google Play's data deletion policies.

findings.issue_summary: App manages user accounts, but NO code, layout, or string suggests an in-app deletion button or process.
findings.evidence: App manages user accounts and authentication flow, but UserProfileScreen.kt lacks any in-app account deletion mechanism or remote data deletion request.
findings.recommendation: Implement in-app deletion: Create a highly discoverable path (e.g., under User Profile/Account Settings) to let users initiate account deletion directly in the app.
